title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health of both mother and baby. A balanced and varied diet will provide the necessary nutrients for fetal development. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and delicious meals.

## Analysis of International Pantry Staples
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and providing energy for the body.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, protein, and probiotics, supporting bone health and the immune system.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, supporting fetal development and preventing anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting brain and vision development of the fetus.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting fetal development and providing energy for the body.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins, minerals, and fiber, supporting the immune system and providing energy for the body.

## Combining International Pantry Staples into Meals
To build balanced and delicious meals, you can combine these international pantry staples with local ingredients. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt, fruit, and nuts.
- Lunch: lentil salad with leafy greens, citrus, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: omelette with leafy greens and citrus, accompanied by a bowl of lentil soup.

## Food Safety Considerations
When preparing and consuming these international pantry staples, it's essential to consider food safety. Ensure that:
- Foods are cooked thoroughly before consumption.
- Foods are stored and handled properly to prevent bacterial contamination.
- Foods are sourced from reputable and safe suppliers.

## Conclusion
These international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women, providing the necessary nutrients for fetal development. Combine these foods into your meals and consider food safety to ensure the health of both mother and baby. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and delicious recipes, visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [read more about related topics](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition or your health, seek help from your doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide you with specific information and guidance to ensure the health of both mother and baby.
